## Context

This is a scoped follow-up to #1 and the implementation in draft PR #2. The source snapshot is commit `9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8`; it is not a claim that the default branch already contains that work. Coordinate the implementation baseline with PR #2 or its merged successor. Issue creation and the ready-for-agent label do not authorize provider launches, trust/permission changes, audit adoption, billing changes or new spending. Follow the execution host’s current policy and preserve existing evidence.

## Triage evidence

- Confirmed current source unconditionally supplies the named missing Cursor billing observation; no supported enforcement-source adapter is integrated.
- No fresh Cursor billing operation or provider inference was attempted; provider capability must be established by the implementing agent.

**Redundancy check:** Inspected billing observation construction, account allowance projection and Cursor-specific admission. No existing integrated source satisfies the requested contract. Existing related mechanisms do not satisfy the specific remaining contract below.

**Prior rejection check:** No rejection knowledge base or matching rejection record was present in the inspected checkout. No other follow-up issue existed at triage start.

## Dated source references

- [Native discovery billing observation](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/src/pilot/discovery.ts)
- [Billing-versus-allowance admission](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/src/pilot/preflight.ts)
- [Existing safe account projection](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/src/pilot/allowance.ts)

The agent-brief comment is the implementation contract. Parent #1 stays open until its independent operational acceptance criteria are met.

> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement
**State:** ready-for-agent, explicitly requested by the maintainer. This means the specification is ready; dependency or runtime gates are not implied to have passed.
**Summary:** Integrate enforceable included-only Cursor billing evidence

**Current behavior:**
Native discovery currently constructs a missing Cursor billing observation with the reason that no supported included-only debit source is integrated. The preflight correctly requires verified Cursor billing. Account tier, available quota and an extra-usage display value do not establish enforced included-only debit. No billing or account change was made during triage.

**Desired behavior:**
Acquire a supported, current, account/route-bound observation of enforced included-Premium-only spending, and integrate it into admission. Never report verified solely from a plan name, balance, display toggle or caller assertion. If the provider exposes no enforceable source, report that exact capability gap and keep dependent execution blocked.

**Key interfaces:**

- `NativeHostInspector.inspect()`, `RouteEvidence.billing`, the `included-only-billing` bootstrap `ControlFact` and the `Observation` state/source/detail contract.
- `classify()`: preserve Cursor-specific required-billing semantics independently of allowance and other providers.
- Current account/control evidence, expiry/drift handling and privacy-preserving projection.

**Acceptance criteria:**

- [ ] Document the supported enforcement source and what it actually guarantees for the exact Cursor route/account; distinguish an enforced cap/debit constraint from quota or plan metadata.
- [ ] Integrate only evidence that can be independently verified and bound to the current account/route and relevant lifetime. Reject absent, stale, contradictory, unsupported and caller-forged evidence with specific states.
- [ ] Portable offline tests cover verified included-only evidence and missing/unknown/denied/changed evidence. No nonverified case may start dependent probes or topic calls.
- [ ] Preserve the existing allowance policy and non-Cursor billing behavior. Redact account identity/credentials from persisted and public diagnostics.
- [ ] No credits, API keys, paid third-party models, overflow, purchases, top-ups, reset redemption or global billing/settings changes are authorized by this issue. Start with read-only capability inspection.
- [ ] Before positive operational closure, verify the existing enforced source through an authorized host/action route and obtain independent review. If that source is unavailable, deliver the precise blocker and required upstream interface without claiming the route is usable or closing the operational gap.

**Out of scope:**

- Cursor trust/read/helper controls, changing an account cap or creating new spending authority.
- Changing the required provider family or treating authentication success as billing enforcement.
- A generic multi-provider billing platform.

**Execution and delivery:**
Work against a revision containing the relevant PR #2 implementation. Recheck the current tree and host policy. Supply portable offline coverage and a reviewable change or validation record, with fresh independent review of material work. Required live evidence must use already-authorized, qualified routes and finite declared call/deadline limits. If a required external capability or permission is unavailable, retain a precise blocker and leave operational completion open; do not substitute a diagnostics-only result for the requested behavior. No global settings, accounts, historical artifacts or unrelated work may be changed under this brief.


**Dependencies:** No sibling prerequisite. Runtime and authorization gates in the brief still apply.
